description: This file defines functions and data structures for reading and aggregating memory mapping information from /proc/[pid]/smaps or /proc/[pid]/smaps_rollup in Linux systems, specifically for the Prometheus procfs package.

classes.name: ProcSMapsRollup
classes.description: Data structure holding aggregated memory mapping statistics such as Rss, Pss, SharedClean, etc.

methods.name: ProcSMapsRollup
methods.description: Constructor for ProcSMapsRollup, initializes memory statistics to zero.

methods.name: ProcSMapsRollup.parseLine
methods.description: Parses a line from /proc/[pid]/smaps or smaps_rollup to update memory statistics.

methods.name: ProcSMapsRollup.addValue
methods.description: Adds a value to the appropriate field in ProcSMapsRollup based on the key.

methods.name: Proc.ProcSMapsRollup
methods.description: Reads and sums memory mapping information from /proc/[pid]/smaps_rollup or /proc/[pid]/smaps.
